name: nas-newsroom
description: NAS Newsroom — internal single-editor newsroom tool (Cloudflare Worker + Static Assets + D1). Local development only; not deployed.

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run db:migrate && wrangler dev --local --var ALLOWED_ORIGIN:http://localhost:8787
